purpose_context: Felix currently reaches Google Calendar through OpenClaw's gog skill, an agent-to-agent path that is fragile and silently broken for inbox-driven scheduling. This mission gives Felix a Felix-owned Calendar helper that talks to Google directly, is multi-account-ready from day one, and reshapes the calendar agent to judgment-only. It is the first concrete step of accepted RFC #681 and restores reliable calendar automation against Kent's real personal calendar.
purpose_tldr: Give Felix direct, deterministic Google Calendar access as a multi-account helper, replacing the gog skill and fixing the broken inbox-to-calendar path.
